description: This dataset contains sediment core measurements from a single event (LTp22-1) collected at a specific location (21.277661° N, 104.690167° W) at an elevation of 1430 meters on April 8, 2022. It includes depth-related data (sediment depth, top, and bottom) and measurements of lead-210 (210Pb) isotopes, both supported and unsupported, along with their standard deviations. The dataset is structured to analyze sediment dating, with numeric measurements representing climate-related data and spatial/temporal references for precise location and time tracking. Researchers can use this data to study sediment accumulation rates, environmental changes over time, and chronological reconstructions in climate science. The semantic profile highlights its role in measurement, spatial reference, and temporal analysis, making it valuable for climate research and sediment dating applications.
